name: Welcome to AbhiHub
aim: Get familiar with searching question papers, finding notes, and uploading materials in 3 easy steps.

steps.title: Search Any Subject
steps.body: Find question papers, handwritten notes, and practicals for your college.

steps.title: Upload & Share
steps.body: Upload your exam papers or class notes to help peers and earn credits.

steps.title: Connect with Peers
steps.body: Discover classmates in your branch and study together.

name: Global Study Search
aim: Instant access to exam papers, lecture notes, lab manuals, and syllabus across all departments.

steps.title: Type Subject or Topic
steps.body: Enter any subject name, course code (e.g. CS101), or topic keyword to filter papers immediately.

steps.title: Filter Results
steps.body: Tap Search to jump directly to verified results matched with your university syllabus.

name: Quick Action Hub
aim: Fast-track access to uploading new materials, finding batchmates, and checking your campus stats.

steps.title: Upload Resources
steps.body: Share question papers and handwritten notes to earn reputation credits.

steps.title: Find Peers & Classmates
steps.body: Search for students in your college branch to share notes and collaborate.

name: Recently Viewed Shelf
aim: Resume reading your last opened question papers and notes without searching again.

steps.title: Pick Up Where You Left Off
steps.body: Your recently opened resources appear here automatically for fast revision during study sessions.

name: File Intake & Scanner
aim: Upload PDF notes, camera scans, and past papers with automatic format verification.

steps.title: Drag & Drop Files
steps.body: Drop your PDF file or tap to select study documents from your device storage.

steps.title: Scan Handwritten Pages
steps.body: Use the Camera button on mobile to snap notebook pages directly into a unified document.

name: Tarika AI Auto-Tagging
aim: Automatically extract subject, semester, and year from document content using AI.

steps.title: Analyze with AI
steps.body: Tap to let Tarika scan your first page and auto-fill college, branch, and subject tags.

steps.title: Batch Apply Details
steps.body: Apply common branch and semester details across multiple uploaded documents with one click.

name: Cloud Storage Sync
aim: Organize uncatalogued files and synchronize your offline study library.

steps.title: Sync Cloud Assets
steps.body: Fetch unorganized cloud papers and verify storage cache status.

steps.title: Monitor Asset Queues
steps.body: Track total cloud assets, sorted resources, and pending review counts in real time.

name: Top Contributor Podium
aim: Celebrate students who upload the highest-rated study guides and exam papers.

steps.title: Top 3 Campus Leaders
steps.body: See the highest-ranking students based on peer upvotes, downloads, and contributions.

steps.title: Check Your Rank
steps.body: Scroll down to see your rank, experience points (XP), and badges earned this semester.

name: Profile & Academic Settings
aim: Keep your branch, year, and college details updated for personalized paper recommendations.

steps.title: Profile Progress Ring
steps.body: Reach 100% completion by filling in your department, year of study, and degree.

steps.title: Update Details
steps.body: Ensure your academic department is accurate so your feed surfaces relevant exam questions.

name: Study Navigation Bar
aim: Read notes distraction-free with page jumping, zoom controls, and instant return navigation.

steps.title: Document Title & Status
steps.body: Verify the document subject, semester, and verified exam category.

steps.title: Return to Dashboard
steps.body: Tap back anytime to return to your library shelf without losing your place.
